---
# Epicentre report template (quarto-epi-report). Replace every <...>, add the
# document to the render list of _quarto.yml and its results prefix to the
# project's registry of report dates, then delete these comments.
title: "<Finding-led title without commas>"
subtitle: "<What the report covers, in one line>. Epicentre, Paris"
footer: Epicentre - Médecins Sans Frontières
format:
  epitemplates-report-html:
    grid:
      body-width: 1000px
    include-in-header:
      text: |
        <style>
          body { font-size: 1.1rem; }
          a, a:visited, a.quarto-xref { color: #1f5bb5 !important; }
          h1.title { font-size: 2rem !important; line-height: 1.2 !important; }
          .subtitle, p.subtitle { font-size: 1.05rem !important; line-height: 1.4 !important; }
          .quarto-title-banner { padding-top: 1rem !important; padding-bottom: 1rem !important; }
        </style>
  epitemplates-report-docx: default
date: last-modified
date-format: long
toc: true
number-sections: true
# Paths relative to this document (one level down in qmd/<topic>/)
bibliography: ../references.bib
csl: ../the-lancet.csl
link-citations: true
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
params:
  # "latest": the newest results in results_dir; a date pins the document
  res_date: "latest"
  results_dir: "output/fits"
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

pacman::p_load(
  rio, here,
  gt,
  tidyverse
)

# Tables (epi_gt()) and figures (epi_font(), forest_ve()) in the template's
# font. This document fits nothing and reads only the aggregate results of
# scripts/<topic>/<topic>.R
source(here("R", "report_tables.R"))
source(here("R", "report_figures.R"))
knitr::opts_chunk$set(fig.showtext = TRUE)

res_dir <- here(params$results_dir)
source(here("R", "report_dates.R"))
dates <- resolve_dates(params, res_dir, "<topic>")
file <- file.path(res_dir, paste0("res_<topic>_", dates$res_date, ".rds"))
stopifnot("Run scripts/<topic>/<topic>.R first" = file.exists(file))
r <- import(file)
stopifnot(all(c("sources", "<element>") %in% names(r)))
data_label <- format(as.Date(dates$res_date), "%d %B %Y")
src <- r$sources

# rounded first, so that a small negative value is not shown as −0%
pct <- function(x, digits = 0) {
  sub("-", "−", sprintf(paste0("%.", digits, "f%%"), round(x, digits) + 0), fixed = TRUE)
}
num <- function(x) scales::comma(x, accuracy = 1)
ci <- function(est, lo, hi) sprintf("%s (%s to %s)", pct(est), pct(lo), pct(hi))
pval <- function(p) {
  case_when(is.na(p) ~ "not testable", p < 0.001 ~ "p < 0.001", .default = sprintf("p = %.3f", p))
}
# the single row of `d` matching the filters, or an error
one_row <- function(d, ...) {
  out <- filter(d, ...)
  stopifnot(nrow(out) == 1)
  out
}

# One helper per quantity the text cites, built on one_row(), for example
# ve_txt <- function(pop) with(one_row(r$ve, population == pop), ci(ve_q50, ve_q025, ve_q975))

# Assertions the text relies on (patterns stated without their numbers)
# stopifnot(<condition>)
```
